title: Tail of a List

entrypoints.name: last
entrypoints.input: A finite OCaml list of arbitrary element type 'a.
entrypoints.output: None exactly for []; Some x exactly when x is the final element of a non-empty input list.
entrypoints.effects: Pure and total for finite lists; no exceptions, mutation, I/O, randomness, or ambient state.

necessary_type_declarations: OCaml built-in polymorphic list: [] | (::) of 'a * 'a list
OCaml built-in polymorphic option: None | Some of 'a
synquid_lowering_types: List a: Nil | Cons a (List a)

trusted_primitive_declarations.name: List constructors ([], (::))
trusted_primitive_declarations.role: Language-provided finite-list representation only; not an algorithmic component.

trusted_primitive_declarations.name: Option constructors (None, Some)
trusted_primitive_declarations.role: Language-provided result representation only; not an algorithmic component.

trusted_primitive_declarations.name: Integer arithmetic/equality in refinements
trusted_primitive_declarations.role: Trusted logical theory used solely for list length and zero/nonzero case distinctions.

forbidden_substitutions: Do not change the signature to accept a seed, bound, index, comparator, or accumulator.
Do not replace the exact final-position requirement with membership, set equality, or length-only behavior.
Do not use mutable state, effects, randomness, or an infinite-stream approximation.
